//: Rainmaker's own preset. The identity is LIGHT — warm paper #fcfbf8, cool ink #0d1015 — so `mode` is light and both gradient stops are the same paper colour: design.md bans gradients, and a two-stop background is a gradient whatever the stops are named. Amber #f5b60a is a FILL and an INDICATOR only; it measures 1.75:1 on paper, so `accent_light` (the token the templates use wherever the accent would become TEXT) is ink instead. The geometry — radius 0, hairlines, no shadow — and the three typefaces live in `rainmaker.css`.
